title: Chapter 277 Undead Beast
content:
Chapter 277 Undead Beast

Wang Shuo stood on the wall of the city wall at the south gate and used the "Abyss Swamp" skill towards the open space in the distance.

Suddenly, a swamp with a radius of 50 meters appeared in the distance.

The huge undead fell into the trap all of a sudden.

Countless arrows shot out from the city wall and immediately shot and killed the trapped undead.

The swamp trap played a significant role, greatly delaying the charge of the undead, thus avoiding the impact on the city wall.

But the other city gates were not so lucky.

"Boom!"

The undead hit the city wall, and the bronze wall rippled.

But this little impact force still could not break the defense of the city wall.

Wang Shuo looked at the overall situation and secretly breathed a sigh of relief.

The first charge was blocked.

The most terrible situation is that the undead will knock down the city wall with one charge.

This kind of situation is undoubtedly very terrible.

At this moment, at least half of the lords encountered this situation.

The city wall was scrapped in an instant.

Some of them have no choice, the strength of the village is only like this!

Some people are lucky and don't pay too much attention to the resurrection of the undead.

This is actually not difficult to understand.

Just like when the plague breaks out, there will always be people who will die.

Let him wear a mask, he won't, just play!

When the disaster is imminent, he will directly blame the heaven, the earth and the society, and never reflect on himself.

For such people, Wang Shuo sneers, God will take it back!

Although the first round of impact did not cause much damage to the city wall, the protracted war in the later period is more critical.

Then, there are all kinds of undead animals, spiders, cheetahs, crocodiles...

What makes Wang Shuo feel strange is that so far, no human skeleton has been found.

Wang Shuo took out the telescope and looked carefully into the distance.

Suddenly, a strange undead army attracted Wang Shuo's attention.

This monster is five meters tall, with a large bulge behind its millstone-sized head.

It's like a hunchback.

On the hump, a dwarf sat on it, filling a basket that could be ejected with some black stones.

"Giant catapult?"

Wang Shuo's pupils suddenly shrank, and he felt a little uneasy. He didn't know how powerful this long-range attack was.

Wang Shuo didn't have to wait too long, and countless stones flew over.

An unlucky city defense soldier was hit by a stone and lost 1,000 health points.

"The attack power is not low!"

The attack range of this monster is not as good as that of a catapult, but it is farther than that of a bronze crossbow car.

In a defensive battle, the catapult can only benefit the most by attacking the most densely populated areas of the enemy.

Moreover, the opponent's stone-throwing monster can move easily, and the catapult is not easy to hit.

This directly led to the fact that Wana Town had no effective means to deal with these giants.

Although Wang Shuo was anxious, he had no choice.

As for the farther distance, there were countless small black dots, and it was unclear what monsters they were.

Wang Shuo no longer paid attention to them, but focused on the battlefield in front of him.

The soldiers dropped a large amount of kerosene, a city defense material that was very effective against the undead.

The intelligence of the undead beasts was lower than that of the demon beasts. They rushed directly into the sea of fire without caring about anything, only knowing to follow orders.

Half an hour later, under the coverage of long-range firepower such as arrow towers, bronze crossbow carts and archers, the undead beasts attacking the city soon became piles of corpses.

The number gradually decreased, which greatly increased Wang Shuo's confidence.
